Context: 4. For Family Planning :

8. Natural Calamities, Bandhs, etc.Heads of Departments may grant Special Casual Leave to employees residing at places 3 miles away from their office, when they are unable to attend office due to dislocation of traffic arising out of natural calamities, bandhs, etc. If the absence was due to picketing or disturbances or curfew, Special Casual Leave may be granted irrespective of the distance from residence to office.
